modules.title: 4x1 Multiplexer — Gate Level
modules.summary: Selects one of four 1-bit data inputs using two select lines, built from NOT, AND, and OR gates.

circuit.caption: Circuit diagram as given in Lab Sheet 2.

steps.label: Module shell — ports only
Two NOT gates for the select lines
Four AND gates, one per data input
Wire the AND outputs into the OR gate

modules.title: Full Adder using a 3-to-8 Decoder
modules.summary: Builds a 1-bit full adder from a 3-to-8 decoder: sum and carry are each an OR of the decoder's minterms.
modules.signature: module FADDER(s, c, x, y, z);

circuit.caption: 1-bit full adder via decoder (Lab Sheet 2, Exercise 1), scaled to 8-bit and 32-bit adders.
